_comment: Allowlist of well-known publish-tool packages, keyed by the ecosystem that publishes them. These packages LEGITIMATELY read publishing credentials and invoke registry publish commands at runtime (when users invoke them). The malicious shape (worm signature G) is doing it from an INSTALL hook before any user action; the hook adapters' allowlist suppression checks the PACKAGE NAME against ITS OWN ecosystem's list and won't fire G-shape promotion for entries here. Ecosystem keying matters: the name is self-declared manifest content, so a RubyGems gem calling itself 'twine' must not inherit the PyPI tool's suppression.
